blocks.title: Read a value at a time

blocks.content: Four of these panels are time series: **Memory / CPU**, **logins**, **server requests**, and **client side full page load**. Each one answers the question: How has this value gone up and down over time?
Time runs along the horizontal axis and the number of requests up the vertical axis. The legend tells the two series apart.
Hover over the graph to read a timestamp and one series' value in the tooltip. Move to a later time and follow the same series to see whether it rises or falls.
A time series needs timestamped numeric values. A stat would reduce these values to one number and hide the pattern.
Open the **Time series graphs** dashboard on its **More Examples** tab.
Now find **Points**. It draws the same kind of data as dots.
Then find **Bars**. The same data again, drawn as bars.
Only the style changes. The timestamped values behind it don't.
